content: Numerous randomized controlled trials (RCTs) have been conducted to assess the effectiveness of real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) across various patient demographics. These studies have demonstrated significant benefits in reducing hemoglobin A1C (HbA1C) levels, particularly in individuals undergoing insulin therapy. Additionally, rtCGM has been shown to decrease both the duration and frequency of hypoglycemic episodes. The efficacy of rtCGM has been confirmed in both younger and older adult populations. It has been shown to improve time in range (TIR), which refers to the percentage of time that blood glucose levels remain within the target range. This improvement in TIR helps to minimize periods of hyperglycemia (elevated blood glucose levels) and hypoglycemia (low blood glucose levels), thereby enhancing overall glycemic control.
